pages.title: Geometric Topology
pages.text: $(thing)Geometric Topology$()$(br2)Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

$(thing)Insight$(): 50$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Calculus, Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Möbius Strip.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A compact orientable surface S with b boundary circles carries Gaussian curvature K, and its boundary curves bend within the surface with geodesic curvature κ. The total curvature integrated over the surface plus along the boundary is 2π times a topological invariant, 2 − 2g − b. Solve that for the number of handles g.
